name: gepa-omni
description: Optimize scorable prompts, code, configs, schemas, SQL, regexes, and agent instructions with GEPA's Omni portfolio and fresh continuation workflow.

interface.longDescription: Use GEPA Omni's parallel GEPA, AutoResearch, and Meta-Harness exploration followed by a fresh continuation to improve prompts, code, configurations, schemas, SQL, regexes, and agent instructions from evaluator feedback. Explicit standalone engines remain available for comparison. GEPA uses a read-only Codex proposer, while AutoResearch and Meta-Harness default to writable Codex workspace sessions with explicit Pi and Claude alternatives.
defaultPrompt: Optimize this candidate against my evaluator with Omni
Help me write a feedback-rich GEPA evaluator
